reviews.text: My dog Leo & I love the South Loop Kriser's! Seeing Gio and Kaely are the absolute highlight of my dog's day, they are so warm and welcoming and always make excellent recommendations based on his needs. They both are a wonderful addition to this neighborhood!

THANK YOU, RAFAEL! 🥰🐾

Our baby Chi is usually so timid and very attached to us, so we were honestly amazed when the second we walked in, he immediately gravitated toward Rafael! When it was time for us to leave, Chi happily went right with him without even a whimper. That alone says SO much about how comfortable and cared for Rafael made him feel. ❤️

And the grooming? Chi has truly never looked better! Rafael’s attention to detail was incredible, and you can tell he genuinely cares about his furry clients.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience and can’t wait to become regular clients! Thank you again, Rafael, for taking such amazing care of our boy! 🐶✨
Love the groomers at this place. They always do a great job with my dog. Would not take him anywhere else.

Adriana is a wonderful woman and every single interaction I have with her I’m blown away at how accommodating, attentive, and friendly she is. She is the exact person to be the face of this Kriser’s. Impeccable services. This entire location has seriously gone out of their way on multiple occasions for me and have really came through multiple times. Above and beyond is putting it lightly. Thank you guys, especially Adriana.
I did ordered food online for shipping, every time they delivery the same day and just dropped off food outside sitting on the rain . O won’t order from them anymore .

I could buy dog poop bags on Amazon TBH……

but I love the friendly face and Convo and this place truly feels like the local dog Mart, I’m not shopping anywhere else for Dog items as long as I’m in sloop. 10/10 experience, Shoutout to Kaley!

I walked in with my two sweet & very excited/wiggle bottomed dogs& I was a little nervous about bringing them into the store since I never do it. The staff was wonderful, one came over to say hello to the pups & help me in my search for a new, sturdy leash and the groomer was kind enough to fit in a spontaneous nail trimming. Although the dog supplies are more expensive than some national pet supply chains/Amazon, I love the personal attention, the assurances that I am buying something that I won’t need to return and the neighborhood feel of Kriser’s. Adrianna is a great manager: she is experienced, helpful and thoughtful.
Very friendly staff, wide selection of products! I bought several gadgets for my golden retriever.

Unfortunately had a very bad grooming experience. Took my Aussie here for a sanitary trim and bath and picked her up completely shaven after explicitly showing pictures and outlining that I did not want anything more than a sanitary trim. They said she had a knot on her stomach so had to shave that area and then to “even it out” shave the entire rest of her. I would rather have a part of stomach shaved off than her literal entire body. It looks ridiculous and choppy as well. At least could call prior to shaving a double coat dog going into summer. Now I have to worry about her overheating the entire summer given she lost her ability to temperature regulate with her double coat. I just pray her coat grows back normally. Very upset about this and will not be returning.

Chazz Warner

Adriana and her team are always helpful, always professional and personable. It is our neighborhood dog house for kibble, can and treats.
Love shopping in this pet store! Workers are nice and they have good deals for their brands of the month.

Kriser’s is my neighborhood pet store and I feel so fortunate to have them here! Everyone who works there is very friendly and helpful, the prices are  reasonable, and they treat visiting dogs so very kindly! I highly recommend them for all your pet needs. Shop locally!

Camara loves visiting Kriser's South Loop. They are always so welcoming to her, and they are knowledgeable when answering my questions. We are frequent visitors and Cammy wouldn't have it any other way. Kriser's carries her favorite frozen raw food and the best snacks that have her going wild to show off her many trick abilities the moment we get home (if she can wait).

Raphael is great with my dog Dory! She is naturally nervous an has a difficult time leaving home... he is great with her and helps her through her phobia. His experience really shines with her grooming- she always gets compliments after her grooming. Communication is great and the staff is super friendly- I would highly recommend this location!

Horrible customer service! I made an appointment for my dog's grooming 3 weeks ago. They call me just as I walking out the door to tell me my appt was canceled. No apologies, the rude women who called has the worse attitude. No consideration for the customer or their pets. If you want disrespectful service this is the place to go.
The staff have always been helpful and kind.  And I have always been able to get my dog in quickly when we walked-in for a nail trim without an appt.  Would highly recommend Krisers
Great customer service. Came in for questions about my sick kittens and was given great advice. I will be returning to support this location and there staff! Thanks a ton
Small but with a good selection. Helpful staff. Great grooming services.
Friendly staff, nice store!
Easy in and out.  Wide selection. Friendly service.
Raphael and Chris are the best groomers in the city. They always do such an amazing job with Logan. I wouldn’t bring him to anyone else in the city. Highly recommend Krisers for their grooming.
Love the pet shop - lots of options for cat food and friendly staff!
Super helpful & knowledgable staff. Incredibly friendly.

While walking Downtown, we found Krisers. What a great store for speciality treats such as freeze dried animal livers. Diverse options for toys and since we are partial to Kong brand, we were happy.  Best part was the free food samples. I use them as treats. Planning on visiting this gem of a store again.
Keila was terrific! My dog looks and smells great!

Your employees are wonderful. I enjoy asking questions and they are great giving answers. They have made my shopping experience great everytime. I love the healthy variety of foods for my furry babies. I'm grateful for your store. Thank you for keeping person to person shopping so awesome!
Really helpful staff and so many great things for your pets.

Excellent customer service! I was greeted immediately upon walking in and the associate was so nice. She provided great suggestions and was super helpful. They have a great selection of cat food and the prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend this store for your pets needs. Five stars!
Great Customer Service

I take my dog to Krisers for grooming. Rafael is great with Bowie, and he does a fantastic job. Aside from grooming, the Krisers staff is great at making recommendations and providing expert guidance. They really care about their customers.
I went in asking for advice about high-protein food for my cat, who has cancer.  The staff were super-friendly and sympathetic and found exactly what I needed.  Thank you so much!
Wonderful grooming job on my golden retriever. The staff is super friendly and natural pet products great!
I’ve been coming to Kriser’s South Loop for 2 years now. Great staff, Cris is absolutely wonderful to my babies.
I love it!
Love this charming little store.  Staff is wonderful!
good place
Excellent staff, service and inventory.

I moved away from Chicago for about 2 years and just came back recently. I have been here before and I have to say that this is the pet barber shop I am most satisfied with, so I still choose this place after I come back, but this will be the last time I choose this terrible place, because this place is completely different from the previous store. First of all, the staff at the front desk，I made an appointment over the phone for my Eskimo，I chose the Full Service Groom  and Premium Shampoo Upgrade,, Deodorizing Package, All Natural De-Shed Package, Seasonal Spa Package.When I checked out, I was told by the front desk staff that I only had a groom and a haircut for my dog. When I asked why my dog ​​wasn't getting other services he actually told me he didn't know. You shouldn’t work here if you don’t know why didn’t the guest enjoy the service he reserved in advance dude! Please stop your daily laziness and give this job to more professional people ！What surprised me the most was when I saw my dog ​​she had all her hair shaved off，It's unbelievable that someone would cut off all of Eskimo's hair when grooming her，I found photos for groomer before he start and told him this what I want ！And this for Mr.Malik ，I saw on your website that you have been in this industry for 3 years but a nice Groomer  needs to have the most basic aesthetics，The first photo below is from when I was here before and the second photo is from when I was here today. Her body shape hasn't changed at all. I can't even believe this was made in the same store .I don't know what happened to this store, but if this kind of store can open, then everyone can. This is no longer the Kriser it used to be.
Nice small pet store with limited options for cats.
My baby Bagel had his hair cut today and was very satisfied (and so was I)! The price was reasonable, and Bagel’s groomer, Cris, did her job wonderfully. We will definitely visit again.
Leda, thanks for the great review! So happy to help.
Very friendly staff and great selection of vetted products!

I stopped in the store with a friend looking for some holiday gifts for my fifteen-year-old dog (and them, for their cats). The product selection was fantastic, the store layout was conducive to finding what we wanted, and we felt welcomed in the store. Thank you!
Staff is super nice and helpful and they have an amazing selection of high quality dog food for every pet parent.

Typically I’ve had great customer service experiences and no problems from a retail standpoint at this Kriser’s. Grooming wise things have been intermittently inconsistent. Today was especially bad and I won’t be returning to this Kriser’s location. I brought my dog in for a grooming appointment, shared the length (3/8) that he’s cut with and wanting the face rounded, but not the mustache doodle look that happens sometimes. After 3 and a half hours (originally told 2hrs) he is finally ready, just to have a disproportionate haircut, inconsistent lengths throughout his body, no nail grinding as initially specified and a chunk of his ear fur cut off leaving him just looking bad. Poor quality especially for what you pay. Not what you want right before the holidays or ever. I’d be mindful of ever bringing your dog here for grooming for anyone besides Cris.
Raphael is fantastic would recommend to anyone looking for a groomer he has so much patience will continue to go back to him

I like the friendly staff that looked up the lamb source of a couple of brands of dog food.  We like local sources.  It was no trouble and  I appreciated our conversation.   Good job fellas at Kriser’s on S. State Street in Chicago!

Everything is in stock because it’s very over priced. Manager Adriana seemed very stressed/ unpleasant and staff seemed unenthusiastic about their shift the energy there isn’t the brightest. I have to really convince my dog to come in to the store. Unfortunately this is the only location near me that carries my dogs food. Nice spot just not for me.
Super helpful and great product selection! I always shop at Kiser’s I love it!!
Yazzie, thanks for the 5 stars!  See you soon!
Great service.  Convenient location.   Fairly priced.
Livi, thanks for the 5 stars. So happy to help! 🐾 …
Misha, thanks for the 5 star review!  See you next time!
David, thanks for the 5 stars. So happy to help! 🐾 …

Thanks for the 5 stars. So happy to help! 🐾 …
The nail trim process was so quick and they did such a great job with my girl.
I love this Kriser’s and they tend to run good deals so you gotta keep your eye out for their new stuff.
Great pet food/supply store in the South Loop. Friendly staff and quality products always in stock!
Adrienne, thanks for the 5 stars. So happy to help! 🐾 …
